home.heroHeadline: We Find What Actually Moves the Needle.
home.heroSubheadline: Relevate works inside your team, not just sends a monthly report. Strategy, execution, and evaluation move together as your business grows.
home.ctaBannerHeadline: Ready to Turn Data Into Growth?
home.whyTitle: Not an agency that lets go.
home.whyLead: We measure success by the decisions you can make, not by the thickness of our report.
home.why1Body: You know who is doing the work and who to ask.
home.why2Body: Written for decisions, not to impress fellow practitioners.
home.why3Body: Each suggestion carries its data basis and expected impact.
home.why4Title: Willing to say it did not work
home.why4Body: Failed tests are reported too, because that is part of the process.
home.servicesLead: Not a long list that never gets executed.
home.svc1Body: Technical audits, keyword research, and content plans aimed at search intent, not just search volume.
home.svc2Body: Getting your brand cited by AI engines: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google search summaries.
home.svc3Body: Content that shows real experience, with authors and sources readers and machines can check.
home.svc4Body: Making sure every page can be crawled and understood, by search engines and AI models alike.
home.approachTitle: Five steps, and the fifth never stops.
home.approachLead: The cycle repeats for as long as we work together. There is no handover halfway.
home.step1Body: Start with the revenue model, margins, and real constraints.
home.step2Body: Priorities chosen by impact and effort, not by trend.
home.step3Body: Technical and content work, with one clear owner.
home.step4Body: We read the data with you, including results that disappoint.
home.step5Body: Once the pattern is proven, we scale it together.
home.approachNoteTitle: That is why we call ourselves a companion.
home.approachNoteBody: Not because the word sounds good, but because this work does not end after one campaign.
home.teamLead: No stock photos. You talk directly to the people doing the work.
home.ctaHeadline: Let us start with a conversation.
home.ctaBody: Tell us about your business and what is holding it back. We will be honest if now is not the right time to work together.
